sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. P.K. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
04.10.2024 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No.164 of 2022, pending on the file of the learned Special Court under POCSO Act, Baripada, arising out of Baripada Town P.S. Case N o . 1 0 5 6 o f 2 0 2 2 f o r a l l e g e d c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 363/365/370/372/373/376(2)(n)/376(3)/109/34 IPC and Section 6/17 of the POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Special Court under POCSO Act, Baripada, by order dated 22.04.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Learned counsel seeks to renew the prayer of the Petitioner before the trial court since in the meanwhile victim has been examined.

5. If such an application is filed, the same shall be considered by the learned trial court on its own merit taking into account that the Petitioner is in custody since 1.5.2023 and it is stated that the Petitoner is the first offender.
6. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Sarat Jagdeep Das vs State Of Odisha & Another ....
